title: podocarpus alpinus var. lawrencii
intro: Podocarpus alpinus var. lawrencii, commonly known as the Kauri Pine, is a coniferous plant species native to New Zealand. This plant is valued for its traditional uses in medicine, as it is believed to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Kauri Pine include its ability to support the immune system, reduce fever, and aid in the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in Kauri Pine include a range of compounds, including podophyllotoxin, which has been identified as a potential cancer treatment.
